## 3. Alpha checks in twice; the feed holds both changes

SDK `POST /entities/<alpha>/checkin` with <alpha credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<check-in 1>",
  "sequence": 1
}
```

→ **200**
